title: Job record
description: The Glass Box job record, CONTRACT.md §11 and §11.1. NOTE ON THE MISSING $schema KEY: this document is draft-07 (see schemaDraft above), but the conventional $schema declaration is deliberately absent, because its value is an absolute URL on the json-schema spec host and the §14 pre-push gate scans full git history for non-local hostnames. docs/corrections/REGISTER.md records the identical case — the $schema field in .claude/settings.json — and the ruling was to drop the field rather than widen the gate's allow-list. Ajv's default export validates draft-07 without the declaration, so nothing is lost. T-019, T-020 and T-021 add three more schema files and will each hit this. One job per generation. Every stage appends one immutable trace record (§11 rule 1). additionalProperties is deliberately left open: §15–§18 were added to the contract additively and attach further fields to this record (§18.1's quality score, §11.3's questions), so a closed record would have to be reopened by every one of them. The closed sets that matter — job status, stage status, and the seven canonical stage numbers and names — are enumerated strictly below.

jobId.description: Allocated from a persisted counter. NOT a §1 identifier — §1 governs sectionId, fieldId and fieldIdN only, and the job-  prefix keeps this out of the §14 gate's 10-digit range check.

status.description: §11.1, closed set. awaiting-input is the human-in-the-loop pause (§11.3).

sectionId.description: §11.1: defaults to null until a section is assigned. When set, a §1 section-range id.

stages.description: Append-only (§11 rule 1). A retried stage appends a second record for the same stage number; it never overwrites the first.

stage.description: §11.0's canonical numbering. replay.fromStage uses exactly these numbers.

status.description: §11.1, closed set. degraded means the stage did not do its real work but the pipeline continued — a success for the job and a warning for the stage.

inputRef.description: §11 rule 2: every stage persists its input as an artifact, referenced by path. Node owns artifacts (§11.2).

model.description: The exact model string that ran, or null if none did. §10 forbids a fabricated value.

confidence.description: §10: null when the stage did not score anything from an image. Never a fabricated number.
